headword: {北方領土|ほっぽうりょうど}

definitions.explanation: Japan's name for the four islands off the northeast tip of Hokkaido (Etorofu, Kunashiri, Shikotan, and the Habomai group) that the Soviet Union occupied in 1945 and Russia still holds. Japan claims them, and the dispute has kept the two countries from signing a peace treaty.

examples.japanese: {北方領土|ほっぽうりょうど}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{四|よっ}つ→四つ：03039_yottsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{島|しま}→島：00885_shima⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The Northern Territories consist of four islands.

examples.japanese: {北方領土|ほっぽうりょうど}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{返還|へんかん}→返還：14357_henkan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}める→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: We call for the return of the Northern Territories.

examples.japanese: {北方領土|ほっぽうりょうど}⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦ロシア→ロシア：31000_roshia⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{平和|へいわ}→平和：01507_heiwa⟧⟦{条約|じょうやく}→条約：04912_jouyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{結|むす}んでいない→結ぶ：02308_musubu⟧。
examples.english: Because of the Northern Territories dispute, Japan and Russia still have not concluded a peace treaty.

notes:
The name reflects the Japanese position; Russia calls the islands the southern Kurils. The government observes {北方領土|ほっぽうりょうど}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧ on 7 February.
